tasks.prompt: Create a new part document at {document} and author an open-top electronics enclosure: outer size 50 mm x 30 mm x 15 mm tall, uniform 1.5 mm walls, top face open. Keep the dimensions and wall thickness as named parameters.

Create a new part document at {document} and author an 80 mm x 50 mm x 6 mm mounting plate with two 8 mm diameter through holes, centred 20 mm from each short edge on the plate's long centreline. Keep the plate size, thickness, and hole diameter as named parameters.
The part document at {document} is a bracket plate with a mounting hole. Change it to 100 mm wide and 8 mm thick, keeping its 60 mm height and the hole. The plate must stay rectangular.

Create a new part document at {document} and author a 60 mm x 40 mm x 5 mm plate with one through slot centred on the plate: 30 mm between the centres of its rounded ends and 8 mm wide, running along the plate's long direction. Keep the plate size, slot length, and slot width as named parameters.
Create a new part document at {document} and bring in the purchased part from the STEP file {workdir}/bracket.step as a fixed solid body, unmodified and unmoved.
The part document at {document} is a bracket plate with a mounting hole. Round every edge of its top face, the four outer edges and the rim of the hole, with a 1 mm fillet.

Create a new part document at {document} and author a tapered round boss with a loft: a 40 mm diameter circular base centred on the origin in the XY plane, blending into a 20 mm diameter circle centred 30 mm directly above it.

Create a new part document at {document} and author a solid pipe elbow with a sweep: a 10 mm diameter round section that runs straight up the +Z axis from the origin for 30 mm, then turns through a 90 degree bend of 20 mm centreline radius towards +X.

Create a new part document at {document} with a compression spring: a 2 mm diameter round wire coiled around the Z axis at a 10 mm coil radius (axis to wire centre), 5 mm pitch, over a 20 mm helix height. Drive the wire diameter, coil radius, pitch, and height with parameters named wire_diameter, coil_radius, pitch, and coil_height.

The assembly {document} places two instances of a bracket part, spaced by a distance mate between their origin faces. Add a third instance of the same bracket component and position it with a new 120 mm distance mate from the right bracket's origin face, in the same way as the existing spacing mate. Keep every mate satisfied.

The part document {workdir}/bracket.ocad.d is an 80 mm wide bracket. Create a new drawing document at {document} with one A4 portrait sheet showing the bracket at full scale in a front view and a top view (the drawing references the part by the relative path ../bracket.ocad.d). Add one linear dimension of the bracket's 80 mm overall width on the front view.

The part {workdir}/bracket.ocad.d has already been widened from 80 mm to 100 mm. Create a new A4 portrait drawing at {document}, with a full-scale front view referencing ../bracket.ocad.d and one semantic width dimension bound to its existing ref:edge:bracket_top_front. Do not use fixed point coordinates. Verify the patch, apply it and export {workdir}/drawing.svg. Regenerate the drawing and report its measured width.

The robot assembly at {document} is missing its wrist joint, but the wrist mate is still present. Add a revolute joint named joint:wrist on mate:wrist with limits -90 deg to +90 deg, effort 0.4 N m, and velocity 4 rad/s. Verify and apply the patch, export {workdir}/arm.urdf, then run reach for tool gripper at point 0,40,7mm to target 120,170,63mm and report whether it reaches.

Add a named parametric datum axis to {document}. Its direction is global +Y and its origin is [axis_x, 0, 0] metres, where the new length parameter axis_x = 5 mm. Set the existing revolve to use that datum axis through axis_feature. Keep the original sketch, radius, height and angle parameters unchanged. Verify regeneration; the moved axis must reduce the original 15/25 mm radii to 10/20 mm over the 20 mm height.
Change draft_angle in {document} from 5 deg to 10 deg. Preserve the datum neutral plane, semantic +x face and all plate dimensions. Verify regeneration and the inward-drafted volume.
Change rib_height in {document} from 12 mm to 20 mm. Preserve the sketch centerline, rib_thickness and base plate dimensions. Verify regeneration and the joined rib volume.

Change tap_depth in {document} from 8 mm to 10 mm. Preserve both M6 standard_hole definitions, the explicit tap_drill representation, diameters, clearance hole and plate dimensions. Verify regeneration and the cylindrical volume; no physical thread helix is modeled.

Change end_radius in {document} from 1.5 mm to 2 mm while preserving start_radius = 0.5 mm, the semantic front edge and the explicit linear radius law. Keep the plate dimensions unchanged. Verify regeneration and review the reference provenance. Endpoint order follows increasing X. Compare the rounded volume to the circular-corner reference with the documented OCCT approximation.
